styleCalmTitle: One small cluster per layer above the selected place; slow motion
styleLivelyTitle: Particles all around the globe, in motion
legendArrow: arrow = significant trend, up or down
legendScale: 25 units span each layer's own record at this place (lowest to highest month).
legendAria: Legend: a small shape is one unit; a big one is five units combined; the tinted disc is this month; the ring is what is usual for this calendar month; a dashed ring alone means no data.
noteOneLayer: The cluster above {{place}} is one value: {{layer}}{{when}}. The thin ring is what is usual for this calendar month. It is not a map.
noteManyLayers: Each cluster above {{place}} is one layer's value{{when}}. The thin ring is what is usual for this calendar month. They are not a map.
